research_goal: every 10 minutes reconstruct the current hydraulic state from sparse causal sensing, use a differentiable action-conditioned hydraulic surrogate to optimize all 109 writable target settings continuously over H120 within an H360 prediction horizon, minimize system-wide cumulative TFV, treat Priority8 PFV as a one-sided soft secondary objective, and execute only the first 10-minute target in authoritative SWMM
development_priority: debug and reject weak model ideas with smoke/dev evidence before any expensive full training or downstream closed loop
